coverage.limits: Complete repository file coverage does not prove all possible semantic interpretations exhausted. Qualified entries are not confirmed violations. Historical causes rely on stored revision descriptions, not hidden model internals.

instances.claim: The corpus instructs a cross-file dependency and compatibility review without recording an execution covering the corpus.
instances.missing_work: The 62 arguments do not have an explicit shared premise/compatibility account; there are six declared finding relations and 251 generic navigation links.
instances.why_it_survived: A toy incompatibility witness and a general review instruction occupy the place where an applied review would have to be recorded; validation only checks existing relation endpoints.
instances.completed_audit_conclusion: The toy result proves a review is needed under the accepted ambition; it does not perform it. Current records support six bounded relations, not the claimed complete inferential arrangement. This audit finds a concrete translation inconsistency in AP-004, so the omitted semantic integration is consequential.

occurrences.excerpt: Consistency also has two levels. [T11](../checks/results.md) constructs four clauses such that every proper subset is satisfiable but all four together are not. Local investigations can each contain defensible commitments while their union is inconsistent. A portfolio of locally checked files therefore needs explicit cross-file dependency and compatibility review.

The findings register therefore keeps subject attribution, support, consequence, and topical connections distinct. Its declared dependencies are reviewed for scope preservation. A general resemblance is recorded as a connection, not a logical edge. Structural validation can check missing references and forbidden cycles; it cannot automatically certify the truth of prose premises.

instances.missing_work: A defined target for truth-condition satisfaction is absent from the Truth routes.
instances.why_it_survived: All translation target IDs resolve, satisfying validation, while referential correctness is not tested. The label became clearer without all of its declared subjects being represented.
instances.completed_audit_conclusion: Recorded acceptance can disagree with truth: an accepted false claim and a rejected true claim supply separating cases. Therefore s-020 cannot serve as truth status. Truth must keep correctness and recorded acceptance distinct; the present map fails its own declared translation criterion.

instances.claim: The promise investigation identifies the needed discrimination but ends by demanding the operation instead of completing even the conditional case.
instances.missing_work: A concrete judgment using the changed intended use and the promise obligation is not derived.
instances.why_it_survived: The section accepts exposing a generic instruction as a result, while shifting the practical reasoning burden to a future procedure. The open demand for a universal algorithm makes the available local conclusion easy to omit.
instances.completed_audit_conclusion: Under the explicitly added premises that a promise does not authorize facilitating an immediate serious harm and that handing over the item would knowingly enable that harm, the promise does not justify immediate return. Withhold that harmful use while retaining the obligation to arrange a harmless return. This conditional conclusion resolves the stated conflict under these premises; no universal theory of virtue is required.

occurrences.excerpt: A capable judgment must recognize the relevant particulars, interpret the commitment, identify competing reasons, and determine an action under a justified account of their force. Calling this practical wisdom can name the capacity; it does not implement or explain it. The actual subject is the capacity to make the required discriminations and warranted transitions under specified conditions.

The positive consequence for autophilosophy is to make a method’s intermediate discrimination visible. A procedure that says consider context can be realized by noticing only the date or by noticing the threatened use; those implementations differ on the required result. The description needs the operation that exposes the consequential change, plus a way for contrary evidence to revise the interpretation.

instances.claim: The proposed positive research direction names proof, precondition verification, and independent measurement.
instances.missing_work: No independent method-effectiveness study is recorded; no universal bridge to reachable execution is supplied.
instances.why_it_survived: A legitimate bounded impossibility result closes the local argument, while the constructive research program remains future work.
instances.completed_audit_conclusion: The proof already supports a concrete trilemma: obtain discriminating information, restrict the domain to cases the information distinguishes, or relinquish guaranteed decisive correctness. Additional rhetoric cannot supply the missing information. Actual effectiveness needs observations; claiming those by deduction would invent evidence.

occurrences.excerpt: The positive research direction is consequently precise: prove the transformations that preserve a stated property; establish when their preconditions obtain; and measure discovery methods on cases that were not used to build them. A successful transformation may uncover a counterexample, clarify a conflict, or give an answer. Those outcomes must remain distinguishable. A method that always reports uncertainty can be honest while making no progress.

instances.claim: The allocation investigation proposes recovering distinctions and demonstrating non-erasing compression but supplies only a loss witness and an enrichment suggestion.
instances.missing_work: No independent reduction of authorization, experience, validity, or normative authority into allocation structure is constructed.
instances.why_it_survived: Refuting a reduced projection is easier than constructing the strongest proposed theory; the universal ontological commitment stays open.
instances.completed_audit_conclusion: Adding an authorization field repairs discriminability of the two records but is not a reduction of authorization. Therefore the current evidence establishes an enriched representation, not the claimed universal identity. A definition that only renames the added field cannot change that verdict.

occurrences.excerpt: An enriched allocation theory can include authorization, institutional history, reasons, and relations among agents. That repairs this example. The resulting obligation is to show how those distinctions are preserved and what the theory gains by calling them allocation. If authorization is merely renamed an allocation relation, the identity has been stipulated. If it is derived from independently specified allocation structure, the derivation can be assessed. If the theory predicts a previously hidden distinction, it has made an explanatory contribution.

The proposed development standard is a pair of demonstrations: recover a consequential distinction that a rival representation loses, and show that a proposed compression does not erase the distinction the question requires. Neither demonstration proves universal identity. Both can establish a real representational advantage.

instances.claim: Constitutive arguments for norms are suggested but not reconstructed.
instances.missing_work: Agency, assertion, and mutual justification are named as possible grounding approaches; none is given premises and a derivation.
instances.why_it_survived: A correct warning against deriving a complete morality from a local norm ends the inquiry before deriving available local commitments.
instances.completed_audit_conclusion: Given the project accepts distinguishing warranted from unwarranted findings, it is committed to retracting a warrant defeated by its own admitted countercase. Refusing that consequence while retaining the acceptance standard is inconsistent. That settles a real project obligation without presuming a complete theory of the good.

occurrences.excerpt: There may be constitutive arguments that agency, assertion, or mutual justification carries unavoidable commitments. They deserve examination rather than casual rejection. But deriving a local norm such as avoiding a contradiction in an asserted proof does not immediately derive an entire conception of the good. Each extension needs its own warrant.

instances.claim: Alternative premise-set support is implemented for A,B,C,D,E but not for the actual philosophical findings.
instances.missing_work: No actual finding contains an enumerated set of alternative sufficient support paths usable by the correction algorithm.
instances.why_it_survived: A toy implementation plus typed prose links is treated as the model for the whole arrangement, although the canonical schema stores arguments as prose and a handful of pairwise relations.
instances.completed_audit_conclusion: The code performs the toy correction. It cannot presently propagate an arbitrary correction through the actual philosophical corpus. The six named relations are useful local annotations; automatic warranted corpus revision is not an implemented capacity.

occurrences.excerpt: An undifferentiated arrow from A to C loses the difference between a necessary premise and one member of an optional support route. The repair represents each sufficient argument as a premise set with a stated rule. Multiple argument sets are alternatives. This is not a claim that every real warrant is deductive or that a formally recorded premise is true.

The findings register therefore keeps subject attribution, support, consequence, and topical connections distinct. Its declared dependencies are reviewed for scope preservation. A general resemblance is recorded as a connection, not a logical edge. Structural validation can check missing references and forbidden cycles; it cannot automatically certify the truth of prose premises.

instances.claim: Source reconstruction stops at three opening fragments while preserving 383 full texts as unreviewed.
instances.missing_work: Every listed legacy full text remains unreviewed; 380 have no recorded text inspection at all, three only the first 11,500 characters.
instances.why_it_survived: Metadata inventory and first-case corrections supply visible coverage and genuine local progress; they do not execute the remaining source investigation.
instances.completed_audit_conclusion: The register is accurate evidence of unreviewed scope. It is not evidence those source arguments have been solved or faithfully translated. No claim of 383 completed substantive reviews is warranted.
